275011375.description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Glass Electrical Insulators Aqua Blue Clear Lot
This lot includes multiple vintage Hemingray-42 glass electrical insulators primarily made in the USA. The insulators feature the classic two-tiered dome shape typical of early to mid-20th-century telegraph and power line insulators. Colors include aqua blue and clear glass finishes. Each insulator measures approximately 3.5 to 4 inches tall. The pieces show vintage used condition with internal bubbles, surface scuffing, and traces of dirt. No visible cracks or severe chips are present. These insulators are suitable for collection, industrial decor, or repurposing projects.
6 x 6 x 4 in
